title: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) — Mock 10
pattern: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 120 min · no −ve)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Disc (suspension) insulators are used for voltages:
questions.solution: Disc insulators can be stacked for any voltage level, starting from 33 kV.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Post insulators are used where:
options: Conductors need to be supported vertically
Long overhead spans with high tension load
questions.solution: Post insulators are rigid and support busbar conductors vertically in substations; tension spans use suspension insulators.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The purpose of a stay wire in an OH line is to:
options: Provide mechanical support against lateral pull at angle/terminal poles
questions.solution: Stay wires anchor poles subject to unbalanced pull.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Anti-climbing devices on distribution poles are provided to:
questions.solution: Anti-climbing guards prevent theft and unauthorized access.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a radial distribution system, the disadvantage is:
options: No supply continuity if a fault occurs in the feeder
questions.solution: Radial system has single feed path; any fault causes supply interruption.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A ring main distribution system provides:
questions.solution: Ring main feeds consumers from both directions, ensuring continuity.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In an interconnected distribution system:
options: Two or more sources feed the network
questions.solution: Interconnected systems have multiple feeding points for highest reliability.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A first-aid room is required at a mine where the number of persons employed exceeds:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.21: a first-aid room is required where more than 150 persons are employed.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Diversity factor is defined as:
options: Maximum demand / Sum of individual demands
Sum of individual maximum demands / Maximum demand on system
questions.solution: Diversity factor ≥ 1. Higher diversity reduces required system capacity.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Demand factor is defined as:
questions.solution: Demand factor < 1 as not all connected loads operate simultaneously at maximum.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A feeder in a distribution system is a:
options: Conductor that carries power from substation to distributors
questions.solution: Feeders carry power from substation to distributors. No tapping is taken.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A distributor in a distribution system is a:
options: Conductor from which tappings are taken for consumers
questions.solution: Distributors have multiple tappings for consumer connections.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A service main connects:
questions.solution: Service main is the last link connecting distributor to consumer's meter.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Underground cables are preferred over overhead lines in:
questions.solution: Underground cables preferred in cities for aesthetics, safety, and reliability.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The main disadvantage of underground cables compared to OH lines is:
options: Higher cost of installation and maintenance
questions.solution: Underground cables cost 5–10 times more and fault repair is more complex.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: As per the Mines Act 1952, women may be employed aboveground only between:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.46: women shall not be employed belowground, and aboveground employment is restricted between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A capacitor bank for power factor correction is connected in:
questions.solution: Shunt capacitor banks are connected in parallel to supply reactive power.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Power factor correction using capacitor banks results in:
options: Increased current for same real power
Reduced current for same real power
questions.solution: Improving PF reduces current, reducing I²R losses.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An 11 kV distribution line uses which type of insulator?
questions.solution: 11 kV lines commonly use disc (suspension) insulators.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Shackle insulators are used for:
options: LT distribution lines and service connections
questions.solution: Shackle insulators are used on LT lines up to 415 V.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a lightning arrester on a distribution line is to:
options: Divert lightning and switching surges to ground
questions.solution: Lightning arresters limit overvoltages by providing a path to ground.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A surge diverter on a transformer protects against:
questions.solution: Surge diverters protect insulation from voltage surges.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The neutral of a 415/230V system is earthed to:
options: Provide a return path and fix neutral potential
questions.solution: Neutral earthing fixes neutral at ground potential.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a TT earthing system, the consumer's earth is connected to:
questions.solution: TT system has separate earth electrodes for source and consumer.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An isolator in a substation is used to:
options: Isolate a circuit for maintenance under no-load condition
questions.solution: Isolator is an off-load device for visible isolation before maintenance.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A circuit breaker in a distribution system is used to:
options: Make and break circuits under load and fault conditions
questions.solution: CB can interrupt load current and fault current.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a fuse in a distribution system is to:
options: Protect equipment by melting during overcurrent
questions.solution: Fuse melts and opens the circuit when current exceeds rating.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a distribution transformer, the core is made of:
questions.solution: Silicon steel laminations reduce eddy current and hysteresis losses.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: No-load losses in a transformer are also known as:
questions.solution: Iron losses occur whenever the transformer is energized, regardless of load.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Load losses (copper losses) in a transformer vary with:
questions.solution: Copper losses = I²R, proportional to the square of the current.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The maximum working hours in a week for an adult employed belowground in a mine are:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.28: no person shall be employed belowground for more than 48 hours in any week.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An 11 kV/433 V, 200 kVA distribution transformer has full-load copper losses of 2600 W and iron losses of 480 W. Its efficiency at full load is approximately:

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Distribution losses in Indian power sector are approximately:
questions.solution: AT&C losses in India are around 15–22%.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The purpose of a feeder pillar (distribution pillar) is to:
options: House fuses/isolators for branching supply to multiple consumers
questions.solution: Feeder pillars branch supply to multiple consumers with individual protection.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, notice of which of the following accidents is required to be given to the prescribed authorities?
options: Loss of life, serious bodily injury, explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water or other matter
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.23: notice is required for loss of life, serious injury, and specified occurrences such as explosion, ignition, fire, inrush of water.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: SF₆ gas is used in switchgear because of its:
questions.solution: SF₆ has excellent dielectric strength and arc-quenching ability.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A pad-mounted transformer is:
options: Ground-level enclosure locked for safety in residential areas
questions.solution: Pad-mounted transformers are ground-level, locked enclosures.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Pole-mounted transformers are typically rated up to:
questions.solution: Pole-mounted transformers commonly used up to 100 kVA.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A single-phase pole-mount transformer rated 25 kVA, 11/0.433 kV steps down to:
questions.solution: 25 kVA, 11 kV/433 V provides 230 V to consumers.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The earth resistance for a distribution transformer earthing pit should ideally be:
questions.solution: Distribution transformer neutral earth should be ≤ 5 ohms.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Two-pit earthing for a distribution transformer includes:
questions.solution: Two separate earth pits: one for neutral and one for tank/body.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The spacing between two LT poles in distribution is typically:
questions.solution: LT distribution pole spacing is typically 40–50 m.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Conductor sag calculation uses the formula S = wl²/(8T) where w is:
options: Weight per unit length of conductor
questions.solution: w = weight per unit length (N/m) of conductor.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Temperature rise in overhead conductors causes:
options: Increased sag due to thermal expansion
questions.solution: Higher temperature → expansion → sag increases.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The minimum clearance of an 11 kV conductor from ground in populated areas is:
questions.solution: IS 3043 specifies minimum 6.1 m clearance for 11 kV over roads.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The minimum clearance of LT (415V) conductor from ground is:
questions.solution: LT conductor minimum ground clearance is approximately 6.5 m over roads.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Stringing of overhead conductors is done to ensure:
options: Proper sag at specified temperature for safe clearance
questions.solution: Conductors are strung to specific sag at reference temperature.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a jumper in OH lines is to:
options: Electrically connect conductors across a pole or dead-end
questions.solution: Jumper wires maintain electrical continuity at angle poles and dead-ends.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transposition of OH line conductors is done to:
options: Equalize inductive and capacitive effects between phases
questions.solution: Transposition equalizes mutual inductances and capacitances.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A sectionalizer in a distribution system is used to:
options: Isolate a faulty section after upstream device clears the fault
questions.solution: Sectionalizer counts fault pulses and opens during dead time.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A recloser in distribution is a circuit breaker that:
options: Automatically recloses after clearing a temporary fault
questions.solution: Recloser detects fault, opens, waits, then recloses.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: While driving approaching old or waterlogged workings, advance boreholes shall be kept at least ______ ahead of the face.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 163: at least 3 advance boreholes not less than 3 m ahead of the face, with flank holes within 5 m on either side.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An auto-recloser is most effective against which type of fault?
questions.solution: Most OH line faults (70–80%) are transient and cleared by auto-reclosing.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Capacitor switching in distribution is done during:
options: Light load hours when voltage tends to rise
questions.solution: Capacitors switched on during light load, off during peak.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A voltage regulator on a distribution feeder is used to:
options: Step up or step down voltage by fixed ratio
Maintain voltage within ±5% for varying load
questions.solution: Step voltage regulators maintain feeder voltage within limits.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, an Inspector may, among other powers:
options: Enter, inspect and examine a mine, and make inquiries on any matter relating to safety
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.22: Inspectors may enter, inspect, examine and inquire into any mine and its records.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An online UPS for distribution communication systems provides:
questions.solution: Online UPS continuously conditions power with zero transfer time.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The maximum allowable voltage variation for consumers in India is:
questions.solution: CEA regulations specify ±10% for LT consumers and ±6% for HT consumers.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A Buchholz relay is used in transformers to detect:
options: Internal faults by sensing gas accumulation from oil decomposition
questions.solution: Buchholz relay detects gas from oil decomposition due to internal faults.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The conservator in a distribution transformer serves to:
options: Accommodate oil expansion/contraction and prevent moisture entry
questions.solution: Conservator allows oil to expand with temperature.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Breather in a distribution transformer contains:
options: Silica gel to absorb moisture from incoming air
questions.solution: Silica gel absorbs moisture from air entering the conservator.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: PMMC instrument works on the principle of:
options: Current-carrying coil in a magnetic field experiences torque
questions.solution: PMMC works on the force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: When workings approach within 60 m of a water body or waterlogged area, the manager shall:
options: Stop working immediately without any plan
Leave the water body untouched forever
Only mark it on the board
Prepare a scheme for protection against inrush and drain the water in a planned manner
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 149 (danger from surface water) & Ch. XI: within 60 m, protective schemes (drainage, barriers) are implemented.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The scale of a PMMC instrument is:
questions.solution: Torque is proportional to current (T ∝ I), giving a linear scale.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Damping in PMMC instruments is provided by:
questions.solution: Aluminum former provides eddy current damping.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Moving iron instruments work on the principle of:
options: Repulsion between similarly magnetized iron pieces
questions.solution: Moving iron instruments use either attraction or repulsion principle.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The scale of a moving iron instrument is:
questions.solution: Torque ∝ I², giving a squared-law non-uniform scale.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Damping in moving iron instruments is provided by:
questions.solution: Air friction damping using piston in air chamber is used.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Dynamometer instruments can measure:
questions.solution: Dynamometer instruments respond to RMS values and work on both AC and DC.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Dynamometer wattmeters are used for:
options: Both DC and low frequency AC power measurement
questions.solution: Dynamometer instruments work from DC up to about 100–200 Hz.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In return airways and old workings, the air shall normally contain oxygen not less than ______ and carbon dioxide not more than ______.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 165: not less than 19% oxygen and not more than 0.5% carbon dioxide.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: If the percentage of inflammable gas in the general body of air exceeds ______, persons shall be withdrawn from the working.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 166: persons are withdrawn when the general body of air exceeds 1.25% inflammable gas.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under the Mines Vocational Training Rules 1966, a person before being employed in a mine for the first time must undergo:
options: Initial vocational training in the prescribed subjects
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 6: every person is given initial vocational training before first employment.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Approaching a goaf, probing shall be carried out ahead of the working for at least:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 147: the working is probed ahead for at least 1.5 m beyond the last support before approaching the goaf.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The standard secondary current rating of a CT is:
questions.solution: CT secondary is standardized to 1 A or 5 A.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A PT (Potential Transformer) is used to:
options: Step down voltage for measurement and protection
questions.solution: PT steps down high primary voltage to standard secondary (110 V).

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The standard secondary voltage of a PT for metering is:
questions.solution: PT secondary voltage is standardized to 110 V.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The turns ratio of a CT with 100/5 A rating is:
questions.solution: CT ratio = I_p/I_s = 100/5 = 20:1.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: CT polarity marking is important for:
options: Correct connection of protective relays and metering
questions.solution: Incorrect CT polarity can cause protective relays to malfunction.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: 'Competent person' under the Mines Act 1952 means a person:
options: Appointed by the owner, agent or manager and possessing the prescribed qualifications
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.2(1)(c): a competent person is one appointed by the owner, agent or manager with the prescribed qualifications for the purpose.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: A loss of 25% is incurred by selling an article for ₹600. For what price should it be sold to gain 20%?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: How many times do the hands of a clock form a right angle in a day?
questions.solution: The hands are at right angle 22 times in 12 hours. So 44 times in 24 hours

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: A product is bought at 10% discount on marked price and sold at 10% above marked price. What is the gain percent on the cost price?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The ratio of the ages of father and son is 5:1. After 6 years, the ratio becomes 3:1. What is the son's present age?
questions.solution: Father = 5x, son = x. (5x+6)/(x+6) = 3/1 → 5x+6 = 3x+18 → 2x = 12 → x = 6. Son's age = 6. Hmm, option D is 6 years. But I labeled A as the answer... Let me fix: the answer should be index 3 (6 years). But I want to provide the options in order where the correct answer is clearly identified.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which is the largest democracy in the world?
questions.solution: India: largest democracy by population

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which planet is known as Red Planet?
questions.solution: Mars: Red Planet

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which is the smallest planet in solar system?
questions.solution: Mercury: smallest planet

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Light year is unit of:
questions.solution: Light year: distance (9.46 × 10^12 km)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Speed of light is approximately:
questions.solution: Speed of light: ~3 × 10^8 m/s

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Photosynthesis occurs in:
questions.solution: Photosynthesis: in leaves (chloroplasts)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: CO2 is absorbed by plants during:
questions.solution: Photosynthesis: CO2 + H2O → glucose + O2

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Vitamin C deficiency causes:
questions.solution: Vitamin C: scurvy

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which blood group is universal donor?
questions.solution: O-: universal donor

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which blood group is universal recipient?
questions.solution: AB+: universal recipient

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Boiling point of water at sea level is:
questions.solution: Water boils at 100°C at 1 atm

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which gas is most abundant in Earth's atmosphere?
questions.solution: Nitrogen: ~78% of atmosphere

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Newton's first law is also known as:
questions.solution: Newton's 1st: law of inertia

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: SI unit of force is:
questions.solution: Newton: SI unit of force (kg⋅m/s²)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: SI unit of energy is:
questions.solution: Joule: SI unit of energy

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
questions.solution: Mercury: liquid metal at room temp
